pk.context: 150 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: Light blue oblong tablets and a 2.5- to 4-fold food-driven exposure boost set this CFTR potentiator apart.

clues.text: Exposure rises 2.5- to 4-fold when taken with fat-containing food. About 99% is bound to plasma proteins, and it is mainly metabolized by CYP3A, with 87.8% of the dose eliminated in feces.
Molecular weight 392.5. A white to off-white powder that is practically insoluble in water.
Approved under an NDA as 150 mg tablets and as unit-dose granule packets of 5.8 to 75 mg. Dosed every 12 hours.
No boxed warning and no contraindications. Headache and upper respiratory tract infection are the most common adverse reactions.
Cystic fibrosis in patients aged 1 month and older who have at least one mutation in the disease gene that responds to it.
Raises the open probability (gating) of the CFTR chloride channel at the cell surface, increasing chloride transport.
The generic name begins with I and has nine letters.
